requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required courses (9-10 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Required courses (9-10 credits): GSS 105 - Introduction to Maps and Mapping 3 credits; GSS 313 - GIS Design and Application I 3 credits OR GSS 317 - Geospatial Narratives: Deep Mapping for Humanities and Social Sciences 3 credits; GSS 314 - GIS Laboratory 1 credit (for students enrolling in GSS 313); GSS 325 - GIS Design & Applications II 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Elective courses (select 9 credits)

rule.manualCheck: The page lists GSS 355, MAR 334, and GEO 347 as OR alternatives in one group. Verify whether more than one of these may count toward the 9 elective credits. GSS 475 (0-3 credits), GSS 487 (0-6 credits), and GSS 488 (0-12 credits) carry variable credit.

requirements.sourceText: Elective courses (select 9 credits from the following): GSS 309 - GIS and Cartography 3 credits; GSS 323 - GIS Database and Design 3 credits; GSS 326 - GIS Project Management 3 credits; GSS 350 - Applied Spatial Data Analysis 3 credits; GSS 354 - Geospatial Science for the Coastal Zone 3 credits; GSS 355 - Remote Sensing GIS Data 3 credits OR MAR 334 - Remote Sensing of the Environment 3 credits OR GEO 347 - Remote Sensing 3 credits; GSS 360 - LiDAR Remote Sensing 3 credits; GSS 390 - Topics in Geospatial Science 6 credits; GSS 475 - Undergraduate Teaching Practicum 0-3 credits; GSS 487 - Geospatial Science Research 0-6 credits; GSS 488 - Geospatial Science Internship 0-12 credits; ATM 320 - Problem Solving with Python 3 credits; BIO 319 - Landscape Ecology Laboratory 3 credits. Note: A maximum of six credits total of GSS 487 Geospatial Science Research and/or GSS 488 Geospatial Science Internship may be applied to the minor.

requirements.label: total-credits
requirements.title: Total minor credits

rule.text: Completion of the minor requires 18-19 credits.
rule.reason: A total credit range across the minor is not a rule type the engine evaluates directly

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 18-19 credits.

requirements.label: unique-credits
requirements.title: Credits not shared with a major or other minor

rule.text: At least 12 credits applied to the minor may not be applied to any major or other minor.
rule.reason: Cross-program credit sharing limit is not expressible with the available course-reuse rules

requirements.sourceText: At least 12 credits applied to the minor may not be applied to any major or other minor.

requirements.label: pass-no-credit
requirements.title: Pass/No Credit limit

rule.text: No more than one three-credit course in the minor may be taken under the Pass/No Credit option.
rule.reason: No grading-option limit rule type exists for counting P/NC courses

requirements.sourceText: No more than one three-credit course in the minor may be taken under the Pass/No Credit option.

policies.sourceText: All upper-division courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Undergraduate Advisor: Nancy Black, nancy.black@stonybrook.edu, (631) 632-9404, E2361 Melville Library. Director: Sung Gheel Jang, Sunggheel.jang@stonybrook.edu.
The page also describes the minor as the Minor in Geospatial Analysis. GSS 314 is required only for students enrolling in GSS 313.
